mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist_quotes (symbol, last_price, quoted_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{lastPrice}, #{quotedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (symbol) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT last_price AS lastPrice, quoted_at AS quotedAt FROM watchlist_quotes WHERE symbol = #{symbol} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE watchlist_quotes SET last_price = #{lastPrice}, quoted_at = #{quotedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
